reason: I can afford it, but I have never seen this battery machine in anyone's house. I won't spend twenty-two thousand on something new until my brother-in-law or a neighbour has used it through a monsoon season and the dealer I know stands behind it.
objection: Will a cold wash really get the mud out of farm clothes, and will that battery still hold a charge after two summers in our heat, or will I be running back to the dealer?
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it working in a relative's or neighbour's house, with my own trusted dealer showing it washing muddy field clothes during a power cut.
